summary: Comprehensive architectural implementation plan for the professional meteorological Analysis Canvas in Alpha Meteo. Details spatial canvas engine, node registry (Live Maps, Map Snapshots, Climate Indices, Charts/Meteograms, Images, Text Blocks, Annotations, and Frames), top-bar workspace switcher replacing the map viewport, Hormozgan Severe Convective Outlook showcase template, configurable Sync Groups, and high-fidelity PNG export.
